// gate: boolean composition and arithmetic operands in the if
// header. && and || short-circuit, ! inverts, parentheses group,
// and + - * / % combine numeric operands under Go precedence; the
// operators exist only in the header.
req := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://example.com/api/users");
api := strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/api");
admin := strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/admin");

zone := "";
if api && !admin {
	zone = "public";
} else {
	zone = "denied";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "public", zone);

status := 429;
retries := 2;
action := "give-up";
if status == 500 || status == 429 && retries > 0 {
	action = "retry";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "retry", action);

limit := 120;
used := 50;
band := "over";
if used * 2 + 10 < limit || admin {
	band = "under";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "under", band);

window := 60;
rate := "high";
if (limit - used) / window == 1 && !(admin || status < 400) {
	rate = "low";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "low", rate);
